title: Pretraining on the Test Set Is No Longer All You Need: A Debate-Driven Approach to QA Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Implementing a double round-robin debate format where language models alternate between defending (Pro) and questioning (Con) roles to analyze and mitigate outcome skew based on assigned positions.

Conducting multi-judge experiments using various LLMs as answer-blind adjudicators to test if rankings remain consistent or if judges inappropriately favor rhetorical persuasiveness over factual correctness.
